text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Hey, you know that thrift store that opened in front of the station?

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Ah, I know that place, though I haven't been there yet.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Um... I am terribly sorry...
Er... the dish behind you—

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Let's check it out this weekend!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Ah, then I'll invite everyone—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: "...Could you take your chatting somewhere else? I'm trying to get some food from right there."

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: A-Alve-senpai... !?

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: E-Excuse me-ee!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...I am... so very sorry...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I just wanted to grab some food.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (...An Umamusume who couldn't even stand up for herself, with no presence at all. But...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: If you were the same as the day you ran beside me, you could've at least told them to "move aside" by now.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (That's right. Back then, you were even more—)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Ahahaha, hahahaha!!
More, give me moooore!!
Let's have some funnn, shall we?!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
By the time the Triple Tiara arrives—
make sure you've become even more... "delicious."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (She carried a ferocious, bellicose aura—)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"The you I know isn't weak at all.
That's why—I will never hold back."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
“—The Triple Tiara.
I'm going to win all of them.”

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Alv-san...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Don't even think you can catch up to me.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

—As I went to the track with Admire Groove
for our usual training...
choice_data_list: There sure are a lot of people today...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Looks like a mock race.
Guess I'll run somewhere else until the track clears up...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Waiting is a waste of time.
Let's change the training order.
choice_data_list: Huh? Is that Still over there—

text_block_list.name: Senior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Is this everyone running in the mock race~?
According to the sign-up sheet, there should be one more, though?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Umm... excuse me... I-I'd like to, too...

text_block_list.name: Senior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!?
S-Since when... have you been there...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
F-For a while now... you've been...
I'm so sorry...

text_block_list.name: Senior Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...I didn't notice at all, my bad, my bad.

Perhaps due in part to her faint presence,
gathering data on her within the academy is difficult.
Which is precisely why—
choice_data_list: I should definitely collect some data on this.
I should definitely collect some data on this.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (...This is the first time I've seen her run in a race format since that training session. ...Let's see what she's really made of.)
—And the mock race began.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(............
She's... right in the middle of the pack, huh...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Normally speaking, this positioning is a blunder.
Breaking out won't be easy... but still.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...You can turn it around from here, right?
If you're truly the same person who raced against me that day.

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"...Was there a girl like this at our academy...?
Whatever... she doesn't seem like a big deal anyway!
Just sink and stay down—"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
.....................
...Well then, it's about time—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: —I wonder if I could have some...♪

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Wh-What...?! Out of nowhere... what is this?! Nooo!
choice_data_list: The pack... it's being pried open...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —...Here it comes!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Ufufu......!
Ahaha... Ahahahahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Give me more... even more...!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what...?!
Wh-what is... that...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(An ordinary Umamusume has no means
to rival her potential...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(To suddenly witness such overwhelming power firsthand...
anyone would feel terrified.)

With every pass, she gained more momentum.
In the end, Still in Love blew past everyone
in one fell swoop.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: As expected, she is—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: H-O-W-A-B-O-U-T-I-T...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(—She... turned around
and smiled back at me...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Which means—
she noticed me and was showing off...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Is this supposed to be her answer
to what I said in the cafeteria...?)

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
""H-How am I supposed to...
...deal with something like THAT, huh?!""

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (Her overwhelming running has the power to break the spirits of those competing against her...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (Even though I've experienced it before, I wonder what would happen if I were to fight now...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (Minimizing the time spent running side-by-side was an effective strategy before, but... will it still hold up from here on out...?)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (If I leave too much space, I won't be able to sweep past them from behind. If I close in too much, I'll get swallowed up. The surrounding situation is—)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"No good.
I can't gather my thoughts..."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I need to... somehow reset my thoughts.

She left her luggage behind and hadn't returned, so I searched everywhere for her.
Thinking she might be here, I came to check, but—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Zzz... *wheeze*...
Admire Groove was breathing softly in sleep in a quiet corner of the spectator stands. If she was here, that means—
choice_data_list: (I wonder if they had some lingering thoughts about the daytime race.)

text_block_list.text:
Amid days filled with the tension of training,
the pressure of being pursued by a bottomless rival weighed heavily.
It must be a heavy burden, both mentally and physically. I want to care for her in those regards. But—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: "Any sort of cozying up... is unnecessary."

She tried almost hypersensitively to keep others from stepping into her heart.
As if she was terrified of something.
choice_data_list: Even so, at the very least—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Was I asleep—
choice_data_list: Nights are still cold. Drink this.
Nights are still cold. Here, drink this.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...This is—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I don't recall ordering that.
choice_data_list: If your health fails, it'll get in the way of training.

text_block_list.text: I start walking without looking in Admire Groove's direction. So she won't realize it's out of consideration.

Listening to the footsteps trailing slightly behind me,
I headed back to the Trainer's Office—
